claim: Aut is generated by inndiagonal, field, and applicable graph factors
The separate graph factor is trivial for twisted groups and standard field representatives preserve relative simple-root orbits

claim: Graph automorphisms act through the Dynkin-diagram S3 and triality permutes the three end nodes

pinpoint: Definition 3.1(b), p. 31 (the square relation follows directly from its displayed root-group formula)

claim: Odd powers give Suzuki/Ree fixed points and even powers give the index-two subfield group
pinpoint: Definition 3.1(b)--(c), p. 31, followed by the parity calculation
independent_corroboration: Suzuki1962; Kleidman1988; manuscript gives the calculation
